visual.zh: 一座窄木桥横跨画面中部，两端连接岩岸，栏杆与桥面清楚可见，岩面和植被向下延伸至深处。
visual.en: A narrow timber bridge crosses the center and joins rocky banks, its deck and rails clearly drawn; stone planes and vegetation descend into the deep gap.

background.zh:
莫特通过基督教青年组织建立跨国联系，推动青年之间的理解与合作。他因对建立跨越国界、促进和平的宗教兄弟情谊的贡献，与巴尔奇平分1946年诺贝尔和平奖。连接两岸的桥是原创寓意，不指代真实地点或组织建筑。短句为原创。
1946年和平奖；获得本年度奖项的一半。获奖理由（中文译述）：为建立跨越国界、促进和平的宗教兄弟情谊作出贡献。
background.en:
Mott built international connections through Christian youth organizations, encouraging understanding and cooperation among young people. He shared the 1946 Nobel Peace Prize equally with Balch for helping create a peace-promoting religious fellowship across national boundaries. A bridge joining two banks is an original metaphor, not a real site or an organizational building. The phrase is original.
1946 — The Nobel Peace Prize. Received half of the prize. Official motivation: for his contribution to the creation of a peace-promoting religious brotherhood across national boundaries
